svg.title: Figure 2 · How the model is checked against the records
svg.desc: Each rule of tools/sysml/check.py compares a record with a model file on every pull request; the views are drawn from the checked model. A finding fails CI.
svg.text: Figure 2 · How the model is checked against the records
Each rule of tools/sysml/check.py compares a record with a model file on every pull request; the views are drawn from the checked model. A finding fails CI.

g.text: parts inside SUS-I1, same parent, name, kind, role, status
parts outside SUS-I1, same name and assumption
connections with the same ends and attributes
actions performed by exactly the performers
satisfy ends inside SUS-I1, matches allocated_to

svg.text: Generated by tools/figures/models_readme.py from the .sysml files, tools/sysml/check.py and the records. The records are the source of truth; the model is checked against them. Passing a check is not a review.

g.text: Terms: CI = continuous integration (the automated checks GitHub runs on every change) · M1, M2 … = mitigation in a hazard record (M1, M2 …), or a SysML model check rule in tools/sysml · OMG = Object Management Group, publisher of

SysML · R01 … = validator rule in tools/pdac (R13 = only a named human review accepts anything) · SUS-I1 = integrated mechanized walker and observation UAV · SysML = Systems Modeling Language (SysML v2) · UAV = uncrewed aerial
